timid.linePrev: By the pretty and the mischievous
timid.line: By the timid and the blessed
timid.lineNext: By the blowing skirts of ladies
stanza: You're the jester of this courtyard
With a smile like a girl's
With the dimples and the curls
By the pretty and the mischievous
By the timid and the blessed
By the blowing skirts of ladies
Who promise to gather you to their breast

timid.linePrev: Like stubborn boys with big green eyes, we'll see everything
timid.line: In the timid shade of the autumn leaves and the buzzard's wing
timid.lineNext: And we'll undress beside the ashes of the fire
stanza: In our days we will say what our ghosts will say
We gave the world what it saw fit and what'd we get?
Like stubborn boys with big green eyes, we'll see everything
In the timid shade of the autumn leaves and the buzzard's wing
